title: After Dhoni: who makes Chennai's last-over calls?
dek: MS Dhoni moves from wicketkeeper to mentor. For Chennai, the hardest job to hand over may be the quiet conversation before the final over.
excerpt: MS Dhoni moves from wicketkeeper to mentor. For Chennai, the hardest job to hand over may be the quiet conversation before the final over.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Dhoni will mentor Chennai after retiring as a player. {{src:announcement}}
Keeper selection and late-order batting can now be assessed separately.

sections.heading: The view from behind the stumps
body: A keeper sees a batter shuffle across before the bowler starts the run-up. From the dugout, that same detail can disappear behind the sightscreen.
That distance matters for Chennai. MS Dhoni has ended his IPL playing career and will serve as team mentor. {{src:announcement}}

sections.heading: What Chennai announced
body: The franchise has confirmed a change of role for Dhoni. {{src:announcement}}
The announcement settles his playing availability. It leaves the captain and selectors room to decide who keeps wicket and where that player bats.

sections.heading: Two jobs on one team sheet
body: In a close chase, Chennai can send in their best available hitter even if their keeper already batted near the top.
For practice, try the same final over twice. Give the keeper control of the field the first time and the bowler control the second. Ask where their readings differed.

sections.heading: What a mentor can pass on
body: A mentor can pause a practice session and ask what gave away the slower ball. During a game the keeper has seconds to spot it.
The successor needs room to make a different call and explain it afterwards. Copying a familiar field can be an expensive habit against a different batter.

sections.heading: What to watch in the opener
body: When a boundary spoils a death-over plan, watch who walks to the bowler first. Then watch whether the next delivery and the new field agree.
That exchange will say more about the handover than a camera shot of Dhoni in the dugout.

sources.title: IPL career over, Dhoni unveiled as Chennai team mentor
